biotools.summary: GENOMICON-Seq is a tool for simulating mutations in amplicon and whole exome sequencing, allowing users to assess laboratory and bioinformatics parameters influencing mutation detection. It generates genomes with mutations and simulates sequencing biases and errors, aiding in the evaluation of bioinformatics tools and experimental designs.
